name: Group Storage
description: Group integration for the Storage Entities module: adds Storage entities to Groups as group content, with access governed by Group permissions.

suggests.drupal/subgroup: Optionally nest groups so storage is scoped across a group hierarchy.
suggests.drupal/ggroup: Subgroup (Graph); alternative to Subgroup for nested group hierarchies.

project_description: Group Storage bridges the Group module and the Storage Entities module. It registers a Group relation plugin (group_storage) whose deriver produces one relation per Storage type, so Storage entities can be added to a group as group content and have their access decided by that group's permissions and roles rather than by site-wide roles. It adds per-group add/create routes (group/{group}/storage/add and .../create), an 'access group_storage overview' group permission, and a Views-based per-group overview at group/%group/storages. Requires Group 3.x and Storage Entities 1.2+, and can optionally be combined with Subgroup or Subgroup (Graph).
